Definition
[Entropy solution, scalar case] ↗ def:entropy-entropy-flux-pair-scalar 1. ch11:11.4-def-5\group Conservation Laws

We call $u\in C([0,\infty ), L^1(\mathbb {R}))\cap L^\infty (\mathbb {R}\times (0,\infty ))$ an entropy solution of (35) provided $u$ satisfies the inequalities (38) for each entropy/entropy-flux pair $(\Phi ,\Psi )$, and $u(\cdot ,t)\to g$ in $L^1$ as $t\to 0$.
